visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of apple-shaped dim sum buns inside a bamboo steamer basket on a wooden table. (2) Transition to a medium shot inside a restaurant where a female staff member in a brown apron walks past several customers seated at tables. (3) A male chef wearing a white uniform and blue gloves is shown in a kitchen setting, carefully piping a cream-colored filling onto rounded dough balls arranged on a baking sheet. (4) Close-up of golden-brown baked buns on a metal tray in a commercial kitchen environment. (5) A person's hands take a snow-topped BBQ pork bun from a white plate and pull it apart, revealing a dark, steaming filling inside. (6) Close-up of three bright orange, apple-shaped buns in a steamer; a hand picks one up and tears it open to show a flowing yellow custard-like filling. (7) A white bowl filled with steamed chicken, rice, a large mushroom, and broccoli is shown, with a spoon lifting a portion of the food. (8) Sequential close-ups of various dim sum items: translucent chive dumplings, yellow fish roe siumai, and pinkish shrimp dumplings (har gow) inside steamer baskets. (9) A chive dumpling is dipped into a small bowl of dark sauce. (10) Two square pieces of pan-fried radish cake are shown on a white plate, being cut by chopsticks. (11) A spoon lifts a large, steamed seafood soup bun (guan tang bao) from a bowl of clear yellow broth. (12) A close-up view of a printed menu with various dim sum items and prices listed in Chinese. (13) Final shot showing an assortment of dim sum on the table, followed by a wide shot of the restaurant's exterior storefront with scooters parked outside.
